caption: The drawing features a rectangular central panel with handwritten German text bordered by a thick black line, with additional text below inside a smaller rectangle. The background consists of stylized, brown and tan floral motifs, leaves, and fruit-like shapes distributed symmetrically along the left and right sides. At the top center, there is a symmetrical ornament resembling a sunflower flanked by two large, ribbon-like scrolls with flowing lines in tan and brown. Below the central text panel, two brown peacock-like birds are depicted, one on each side, both standing among stylized plants with drooping leaves and pointed petals, facing towards the center. The colors throughout are in a muted palette dominated by browns, yellows, and tans, with all elements outlined and shaded in darker brown ink.
title: Fraktur
